messages.text: 'More risk earlier!' - Norris braces for 'tougher' Monaco with shock Sprint

metadata.summary: World champion Lando Norris believes Formula 1 drivers will face a greater challenge at next year's Monaco Grand Prix than normal due to the addition of the Sprint format.
metadata.content: Lando Norris: McLaren driver reacts to Monaco Sprint news for 2027 season after Formula 1 calendar surprise | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Exclusive Lando Norris: McLaren driver reacts to Monaco Sprint news for 2027 season after Formula 1 calendar surprise The Monaco Grand Prix was named as one of 10 Sprint venues on the 2027 race calendar; Norris says only one practice session will test drivers; watch every session of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix from September 24-26 with a Saturday race, live on Sky Sports F1 Thursday 17 September 2026 07:43, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Lando Norris reacts to the news that the Monaco Grand Prix will be a Sprint event in 2027 World champion Lando Norris believes Formula 1 drivers will face a greater challenge at next year's Monaco Grand Prix than normal due to the addition of the Sprint format. The 24-round 2027 calendar, published on Wednesday, includes 10 Sprint weekends - four more than this season - with Monaco's street circuit to host the alternative format for the first time. The Principaliy's narrow track is not known for overtaking, where the Sprint format has hitherto tended to be used, but is considered arguably the greatest challenge in the sport for an F1 driver when it comes to qualifying. metadata.summary: Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies says they will continue to prioritise Isack Hadjar's recovery over rushing his return from injury, with evaluations planned before a call on whether he races at next week's Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
metadata.content: Isack Hadjar: Red Bull driver's injury recovery going to plan as team provide update on next steps ahead of Azerbaijan GP decision | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Isack Hadjar: Red Bull driver's injury recovery going to plan as team provide update on next steps ahead of Azerbaijan GP decision Red Bull's Isack Hadjar has missed three races since the summer break with an injured wrist; team to assess whether Hadjar is ready to return ahead of Baku; watch every session of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix from September 24-26 with a Saturday race, live on Sky Sports F1 Thursday 17 September 2026 06:28, UK Image: Isack Hadjar could return to action on the streets of Baku Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies says they will continue to prioritise Isack Hadjar's recovery over rushing his return from injury, with evaluations planned before a call on whether he races at next week's Azerbaijan Grand Prix. Hadjar has missed the last three races after sustaining a wrist injury during routine training ahead of the sport's return to action from its summer break. Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson has stood in for him. Speaking after last Sunday's Spanish Grand Prix, Mekies said Hadjar's recovery was going to plan, with a simulator session planned to help assess his readiness for any return to action in Baku. messages.text: Co-owners Boehly and Walter agree to sell Chelsea stakes

metadata.summary: Chelsea chairman Todd Boehly and director Mark Walter have agreed to sell their 25 per cent stake in the club to majority shareholders Clearlake Capital in a deal which values Chelsea at £5bn.
metadata.content: Chelsea: Todd Boehly and fellow co-owner Mark Walter to sell stakes in Premier League club | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Chelsea: Todd Boehly and fellow co-owner Mark Walter to sell stakes in Premier League club Chelsea majority owners Clearlake Capital own 61.5 per cent of club; Todd Boehly and Mark Walter own 12.8 per cent, but pair have held talks over selling shares to Clearlake, who are led by Behdad Eghbali and Jose Feliciano; Boehly was face of consortium which bought club four years ago Thursday 17 September 2026 08:34, UK Image: Todd Boehly has stepped down as Chelsea chairman and agreed to sell his stake in the club Chelsea chairman Todd Boehly and director Mark Walter have agreed to sell their 25 per cent stake in the club to majority shareholders Clearlake Capital in a deal which values Chelsea at £5bn. The deal paves the way for Clearlake to take full control of Chelsea, owning 86.5 per cent of the club, with Swiss billionaire Hansjorg Wyss owning 13.5 per cent. Boehly was the face of the consortium which bought Chelsea in 2022 but Clearlake co-founder Behdad Eghbali has become the most powerful figure at the club. Chelsea say there will be no changes to the day-to-day operations, leadership or strategy at the club following this transaction. Boehly and Walter are making a small profit on their investment. metadata.summary: The European Elite Boxing Championships begin in Sofia, Bulgaria on Thursday with GB entering a strong team dotted with Commonwealth Games gold medallists.
metadata.content: Amy Broadhurst continues comeback at European championships: 'This will be my last shot at the Olympics' | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to content Exclusive Amy Broadhurst continues comeback at European championships: 'This will be my last shot at the Olympics' Amy Broadhurst is continuing her boxing comeback after becoming a mother; A World and European gold medallist for Ireland, Broadhurst has switched to GB and will box for Britain at the European Championships, her first major tournament since having a baby John Dennen Sports Journalist @johndennen Thursday 17 September 2026 06:27, UK Image: Broadhurst will box for GB at the European championships in Bulgaria. The European Elite Boxing Championships begin in Sofia, Bulgaria on Thursday with GB entering a strong team dotted with Commonwealth Games gold medallists. Amy Broadhurst, a former World and European gold medallist for Ireland, will be part of the squad boxing for Britain. Broadhurst, a key sparring partner for Katie Taylor for the Irish legend's first iconic victory over Amanda Serrano, switched from Ireland to Britain ahead of Paris 2024 as she sought to qualify for the Olympic Games.
